title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.11][quality] Repair redaction and hot-reload validation integrity
goal: Replace vacuous or scheduler-dependent validation with deterministic proof for Observatory redaction and Runtime hot-reload cancellation.
summary: Repair the OBS-B publication redaction validator and synchronize hot-reload cancellation tests on observable watcher and debounce state.
required_outcome: Both validation surfaces prove the intended security and cancellation behavior deterministically across repeated focused runs.
target_files_surfaces: .csdlc/prepared/issues/512/validate-obs-b-redaction.sh; adl-runtime/tests/config_reload.rs; tightly coupled fixtures or testability seams only
repo_inputs: Issue #816; #520 findings D520-SEC-003 and D520-TEST-001; current OBS-B publication manifest and Runtime hot-reload implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Redaction validates actual publication-shaped Runtime/UI/evidence data and rejects representative secrets and provider payloads; cancellation tests wait for watcher receipt and pending debounce before revert or deletion; repeated focused proof is deterministic without fixed scheduler sleeps.
non_goals: No Observatory redesign and no general watcher refactor beyond the smallest deterministic testability seam.
validation_plan: Positive and negative OBS-B publication-shaped fixtures; repeated focused hot-reload cancellation tests; formatting and diff hygiene.
dependencies: Parent #522 and internal review #520; no implementation dependency remains.
demo_proof_requirements: Deterministic local validation proof only; no live cloud or UI demo.
inputs: Issue #816 and the two exact internal-review findings.
notes_risks: A test that only observes generation zero can pass without exercising cancellation; a redaction scan over planning prose can pass without scanning publication data.
deliverables: Publication-shaped redaction validator fixtures and deterministic hot-reload cancellation tests.
tooling_notes: Native v3 bound FastWork worktree; focused local validation.
issue_graph_note: Child remediation of #522 for #520 findings D520-SEC-003 and D520-TEST-001.
issue_graph_notes: Do not widen into unrelated review findings.
